coverage.reason: No title, HUD, settings or camera surfaces change; this is GameRoom occupancy only.
Canonical public-live-v2 must keep assignment, names and scores through eviction and alarm restore.
Private graybox rooms and observation stay excluded from the always-on public city.
Companion feed for public-live-v2 stays current while overflow rooms retire from the admission directory.
Existing Cloudflare Durable Object alarm and lifecycle contract is the only wake mechanism.
No player, observer or title controls change for this occupancy policy.
Worker tests must prove initial eight, zero-human progress, restore, alarm persistence, feed freshness, overflow retirement and private exclusion.
A dedicated public city keeps simulating with zero humans while overflow rooms dispose when empty.

platform_constraints: One Durable Object alarm at a time; merge respawn, reset, refill, reconnect and heartbeat deadlines into that single alarm.
Alarms are at-least-once. Uncaught alarm() failures retry with exponential backoff from two seconds, at most six times, then exhaust until the next setAlarm.
Constructor and blockConcurrencyWhile hydration must read getAlarm before setAlarm so a wake cannot clobber the pending alarm that invoked the constructor.
No new npm dependency. Keep wrangler 4.129.0 and the existing GameRoom Durable Object plus Matchmaker stack.
Preserve MAX_PLAYERS 10, occupied-room backfill to eight, RECONNECT_GRACE_MS 30000, private-room exclusion and empty overflow sleep.

direct.name: wrangler
direct.compatibility: Locked Cloudflare Worker plus Durable Object stack already used by GameRoom and Matchmaker. No added dependency.
direct.ownership: GameRoom owns the canonical eight-bot roster, assignment clock, names and scores; wrangler and workerd own Durable Object isolation.

behavior.behavior: SV_Frame keeps calling GAME_RUN_FRAME on a dedicated loaded map even when no human clients are connected; empty dedicated play still advances world time, bots and scores.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy GPL Quake source, dedicated-server cvars, bot frame timing or snapshot encoding.

platform.requirement: Canonical public-live-v2 must persist assignment, names and scores incrementally and keep an alarm so eviction or hibernation reconstructs the still-running eight-bot match instead of sleeping the city.

direct.ownership: GameRoom.scheduleNextAlarm owns merging one alarm; Cloudflare owns at-least-once delivery, six retries and exhaustion.

behavior.behavior: One setAlarm per object; getAlarm before constructor setAlarm so wake does not clobber the pending alarm; at-least-once alarm() with two-second exponential backoff for six retries, then exhaustion until the next setAlarm.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy documentation markup, sample AgentServer storage keys or Cloudflare branding.

platform.requirement: Keep a single Durable Object alarm. Constructor hydration must preserve any existing alarm. Catch alarm failures and reschedule before returning so six-retry exhaustion cannot permanently stop the canonical city.

Obligation for test/worker/canonicalCity.test.ts: alarm recovery must keep one alarm, at-least-once delivery, six retries, then exhaustion until the next setAlarm. This is a required assertion, not a claim of current coverage.

direct.ownership: Matchmaker owns overflow admission and retirement; GameRoom owns the canonical-versus-private occupancy split; public observation stays rejected.

behavior.behavior: autoDispose rooms call dispose when no clients, no reserved seats and no in-flight onLeave remain; a room that is not the always-on city is removed from the matchmaker once empty.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy Colyseus seat reservation, auth hooks, schema sync or room lifecycle code.

platform.requirement: Empty overflow GameRooms delete their alarm and may become inactive. Private graybox rooms never receive the canonical always-on eight. Occupied rooms still cap at ten rats and backfill to eight, with a thirty-second reconnect reservation.
